name: Gyakuten★ Onii-chan to Watashi ga Gyaku ni Nacchatta!!
original_name: 逆転★ お兄ちゃんと私が逆になっちゃった！！
source:
The story of an elder brother and younger sister that suddenly switch bodies.

She's a maiden with a strong sense of chastity.
He's a playboy that loves to f*ck around.

What do you think happens......? The obvious of course.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ193623.html]DLsite English[/url]]

讲述一对兄妹某天突然互换身体的故事。

妹妹是贞操观念极强的纯洁少女。
哥哥则是到处鬼混猎艳的花花公子。

你猜接下来会发生什么……？当然是喜闻乐见的展开啦。
